facts.business: The company is engaged in the manufacturing and supply of automobile pistons, piston rings, and piston pins for two-wheelers, three-wheelers, passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, tractors, and stationary engine applications.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Future growth will be driven through expansion of the product portfolio, development of Aluminium Cylinder Blocks, expansion of Engine Valve and Connecting Rod businesses, and capacity enhancement and automation of manufacturing operations.
guidance_or_targets.value: Product portfolio expansion, Aluminium Cylinder Blocks, Engine Valve and Connecting Rod businesses, capacity enhancement and automation

auditor.name: Shri M V N Murthy
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: No qualifications, reservations or adverse remarks

key_risks: Increasing competition within the automotive component industry
Gradual shift towards electric mobility impacting demand for conventional engine components
facts.related_party_note: All Related Party Transactions entered during the financial year were on an arm's length basis and in the ordinary course of business. The Company had not entered into any contract/arrangement/transaction with related parties in terms of Section 188 of the Companies Act, 2013. Form AOC-2 is not applicable. There were no materially significant related party transactions which could have potential conflict with the interest of the Company at large.
